name: feedback-holder-presentation
description: Require exactly one real Feedback event, one count increment, and one visible presentation for a gated Rebirth and an ephemeral Studio premium grant. Numeric baselines are captured before triggers; commerce prompts are not used as grants.

steps.label: start play and wait for runtime DataModels

args.code:
assert(game:GetService('RunService'):IsStudio(),'fixture is Studio-only')
local function verifyEphemeralSeed(player,world,storage)
 assert(world and world:GetAttribute('PersistenceMode')=='EphemeralStudio','refusing fixture Reset outside EphemeralStudio')
 assert(world:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioDefaultEphemeral')==true and world:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioLiveDataOptIn')==false,'refusing live-data Studio fixture')
 assert(storage:GetAttribute('PunchWallAllowLiveDataStoreAccess')~=true,'live DataStore opt-in forbids fixture Reset')
 assert(player:GetAttribute('ProfileReady')==true and player:GetAttribute('ProfilePersistenceState')=='EphemeralStudio' and player:GetAttribute('ProfileWritable')==false,'fixture profile must be ready, ephemeral and non-writable')
 return true
end
assert(#game.Players:GetPlayers()==1,'requires one isolated player')
verifyEphemeralSeed(game.Players:GetPlayers()[1],workspace:FindFirstChild('PunchWallRPG'),game.ServerStorage)
local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation assert(c:Invoke('Reset').ok==true,'reset failed') c:Invoke('SetStats',{WallLevel=1,Coins=0,Rebirths=0,OwnedPremiumPetsJSON='[]',PetInventoryJSON='[]',EquippedPetsJSON='[]'}) return true

steps.label: prepare rejected rebirth and fresh premium state

args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local g=p.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD
local events=game.ReplicatedStorage.PunchWallEvents
local function captureFeedbackView()
 local function count(holder)
  local n=0 local texts={}
  if not g.Enabled or not holder.Visible then return n,texts end
  for _,d in ipairs(holder:GetChildren()) do
   if d:IsA('GuiObject') and d.Visible and d.AbsoluteSize.X>0 and d.AbsoluteSize.Y>0 then
    n+=1 if d:IsA('TextLabel') or d:IsA('TextButton') then table.insert(texts,d.Text) end
   end
  end
  return n,texts
 end
 local toasts,toastTexts=count(g.Toasts)
 local rewards,rewardTexts=count(g.RewardPops)
 local channels=(toasts>0 and 1 or 0)+(rewards>0 and 1 or 0)
 return {toasts=toasts,rewards=rewards,channels=channels,presented=channels==1,toastHolder=g.Toasts.Visible,rewardHolder=g.RewardPops.Visible,toastTexts=toastTexts,rewardTexts=rewardTexts}
end
local function verifyFeedbackEvidence(e,expectedType,expectedTarget)
 assert(e.presentationCaptured==true,'actual visible presentation was not captured')
 assert(e.baselineVisualCount==0,'feedback fixture was not visually empty')
 assert(type(e.before)=='number' and type(e.after)=='number' and e.after-e.before==1 and e.delta==1,'expected exactly one counted feedback')
 assert(e.eventCount==1 and #e.events==1,'expected exactly one actual Feedback event')
 assert(e.events[1].type==expectedType and e.events[1].target==expectedTarget,'wrong Feedback event identity')
 assert(e.type==expectedType and e.target==expectedTarget,'wrong last displayed feedback identity')
 assert(e.channels==1 and e.toasts+e.rewards==1 and e.presented==true,'expected exactly one visible feedback instance/channel')
 return true
end
g.PunchWallClientAutomation:Invoke('ClearToasts')
local emptyDeadline=os.clock()+4
local initial
repeat initial=captureFeedbackView() if initial.toasts+initial.rewards==0 then break end task.wait(.05) until os.clock()>=emptyDeadline
assert(initial.toasts+initial.rewards==0,'feedback fixture did not clear')
local before=tonumber(g:GetAttribute('FeedbackCount')) or 0
local evidence={before=before,baselineVisualCount=initial.toasts+initial.rewards,eventCount=0,events={}}
local connection=events.Feedback.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
 evidence.eventCount+=1 table.insert(evidence.events,{type=tostring(payload.type or ''),target=tostring(payload.target or '')})
end)
events.ActionRequest:FireServer({action='Rebirth'})
local deadline=os.clock()+4
repeat task.wait(.05) until evidence.eventCount>0 or os.clock()>=deadline
task.wait(.3)
connection:Disconnect()
local view=captureFeedbackView()
for key,value in pairs(view)do evidence[key]=value end
evidence.presentationCaptured=true
evidence.after=tonumber(g:GetAttribute('FeedbackCount')) or 0
evidence.delta=evidence.after-evidence.before
evidence.type=tostring(g:GetAttribute('LastFeedbackType') or '')
evidence.target=tostring(g:GetAttribute('LastFeedbackTarget') or '')
local encoded=H:JSONEncode(evidence)
local ok,reason=pcall(verifyFeedbackEvidence,evidence,'Fail','Rebirth')
assert(ok,'Rebirth feedback evidence failed: '..tostring(reason)..' '..encoded)
g:SetAttribute('FeedbackContractRebirthJSON',encoded)
return encoded

assert(game:GetService('RunService'):IsStudio(),'fixture is Studio-only')
local function verifyEphemeralSeed(player,world,storage)
 assert(world and world:GetAttribute('PersistenceMode')=='EphemeralStudio','refusing fixture Reset outside EphemeralStudio')
 assert(world:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioDefaultEphemeral')==true and world:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioLiveDataOptIn')==false,'refusing live-data Studio fixture')
 assert(storage:GetAttribute('PunchWallAllowLiveDataStoreAccess')~=true,'live DataStore opt-in forbids fixture Reset')
 assert(player:GetAttribute('ProfileReady')==true and player:GetAttribute('ProfilePersistenceState')=='EphemeralStudio' and player:GetAttribute('ProfileWritable')==false,'fixture profile must be ready, ephemeral and non-writable')
 return true
end
assert(#game.Players:GetPlayers()==1,'requires one isolated player')
verifyEphemeralSeed(game.Players:GetPlayers()[1],workspace:FindFirstChild('PunchWallRPG'),game.ServerStorage)
local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1]
assert(not table.find(H:JSONDecode(p.RPGStats.OwnedPremiumPetsJSON.Value),'Crimson Phoenix'),'premium grant fixture already owned')

assert(result.ok==true,'deterministic premium grant failed')
assert(table.find(H:JSONDecode(p.RPGStats.OwnedPremiumPetsJSON.Value),'Crimson Phoenix') and table.find(H:JSONDecode(p.RPGStats.PetInventoryJSON.Value),'Crimson Phoenix'),'premium authority did not grant exact pet')
return H:JSONEncode({ok=true,source='StudioAutomation',pet='Crimson Phoenix'})
